title: Enterprise Production RAG & Billion-Scale Vector Search Engine Selection Guide: Azure AI Search vs. Milvus 2.5 (DiskANN/CAGRA) vs. Qdrant vs. PostgreSQL pgvectorscale

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Uncompressed In-Memory FP32 HNSW + Dense-Only Retrieval (No BM25 or Reranker)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Obsolete at >=50M vectors due to 10x RAM bloat and poor exact-keyword recall

tiers.tier: Tier 2: HNSW SQ8 Quantization + Naive Post-Retrieval ACL Filtering
tiers.recommended_scenario: Post-filtering causes empty top-K results for restricted-permission users

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Turnkey Azure AI Search (Compressed Vector + BM25 RRF + L2 Semantic Ranker + Entra ACL)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Best fit for M365/Azure enterprise RAG needing zero-ops document ACL security trimming

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (High-Scale Recommended): NVMe DiskANN / BQ + Hybrid BM25 + Bitmap Pre-ACL + Cross-Encoder Rerank
tiers.recommended_scenario: 100M-to-10B vector gold standard (Milvus 2.5 / Qdrant / pgvectorscale) cutting RAM by 92.0% and TCO by 81.6%
